description: Search API for AI agents: web or news search with up to 30 results per call, each with a title, URL and a query-relevant excerpt. Filter by site, or by category: developer (repos, issues, docs), GitHub or PDF. Fast, about a second. Pay per call in stablecoins.

category.description: restrict web results: developer (repos, issues, docs), github or pdf

exclude_domains.description: leave out these hostnames; not together with include_domains

include_domains.description: only results from these hostnames, e.g. ["docs.python.org"]; not together with exclude_domains

limit.description: number of results (billed in pages of 10) wanted, 1 to 30 (default 10). A larger value is lowered to 30 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

query.description: search keywords, e.g. "fastapi websocket disconnect" (not a URL; quoted phrases, -term and site:host work)

name: search-plus
title: Web or news search with excerpts
